scope: Bounded background native changed-flow evidence. Not installed acceptance or a whole-current glass campaign.

source.oldIdentityNote: Reconstructed from recorded source revision; no old full-bundle hash claimed.
source.build: Actual Xcode Debug MCPRouter scheme, macOS destination, one job, signing disabled; genuine build freshness source/bundle stamp validated after capture.

isolation: Explicit temporary router HOME, Debug in-memory token store and temporary observations directory. One authored usage record; one declared HTTP target at loopback port1, never invoked. No provider, owner history, owner Keychain or live listener.

acknowledgedWriteThenReadbackFailure.readbackFailure: One-shot controlled proxy refusal; write passed through to the actual router.
acknowledgedWriteThenReadbackFailure.notice: The router accepted the history reset. Updated history could not be verified.
acknowledgedWriteThenReadbackFailure.Activity: One recorded call became zero after close refresh.
acknowledgedWriteThenReadbackFailure.Cleanup: One-day history/no proposal became a fresh seconds-old window with one never-used candidate.
acknowledgedWriteThenReadbackFailure.disk: Actual active log removed and aggregate reset to an empty server map.

response.error: Usage history reset failed during commit (EISDIR). Some history files were removed; the reset did not complete. Reload usage before trying again.

actualPartialWriteFailure.arrangement: Only the private stats commit target was temporarily changed to a directory. Actual reset removed one JSONL then refused rename with EISDIR; fixture restored after probe.
actualPartialWriteFailure.notice: The history reset could not be verified. Current readings may be incomplete.
actualPartialWriteFailure.Activity: Freshly read active history became zero records.
actualPartialWriteFailure.Cleanup: Fresh GET retained the previous one-call aggregate and one-day window, matching the router; no invented completed reset.

layoutRegression.result: Old split and subtitle escaped the window. After the intrinsic sizing fix both fit in populated and empty states at900x450 and1100x728; native screenshots inspected. No clipping or fixed content-height workaround.
layoutRegression.discardedProbe: A detached NSHostingView fittingSize assertion passed old source and was discarded. It is not a regression guard.

nativeLifecycle.AXPressCloseAll: Closed the ordinary main window; Settings and its pending acknowledged-reset sheet remained.
nativeLifecycle.result: No reachable pending-sheet Settings destruction established. No speculative onDisappear workaround added.

nativeEvidence.actor: Proctor AXPress/menu/value writes with foreground:false; measured synthetic events0.
nativeEvidence.settingsEntry: PID-directed CGEvent.postToPid cmd-comma; sampled foreground PID unchanged. No global key or click.
nativeEvidence.settle: AX quiet only on live windows; compositor regionQuiet timed out because trace updates. No frame-quiescence claim.
nativeEvidence.sourcePopulation: Actual normal app, not a hosted fixture renderer.

validation.command: swift test --package-path app --scratch-path <isolated existing scratch> --jobs 1 --filter Activity|Settings|SheetShortcutGuard
